title: Concept: Privileged workflow triggered by workflow_run in yaml — review required
description: In yaml, a workflow listens on workflow_run. That event runs with the base repository’s privileges after a run that may have been started by an outside contributor. Jobs that download the triggering artifacts or check out its commit therefore execute attacker-influenced content with a token that can write to the repository.
applicability: yaml repositories that chain workflows across events.
risk: Privileged execution of untrusted workflow output; HIGH severity.
